csv_project_name: AE for Drop Ceiling Install & Add Sound Proofing
csv_scope_of_work: Benton County is requesting Statements of Qualification from firms interested in providing Architectural Services and Engineering Design - Drop Ceiling Installation and Additional Sound Proofing for the Benton County facility at 2109 & 2113 W. Walnut, Rogers, AR 72756. The new ceiling will be going into the Collector/Assessor s area. The area is approximately 3,200 SF and will require new HVAC ducts, diffusers grills, and 2 x4 flat panel LED light fixtures to match the existing offices. All existing sprinkler heads will need to be adjusted to meet the height of the new ceiling. All existing 4 linear pendant fixtures in the space are to be carefully removed and given to the county for storage and potential re-use.

- Administrative buildings are explicitly low priority for sbp.
